Tesla Will Invest $3.31 Billion to Expand German Factory for Cybercab Production

Tesla will add a new facility at its Berlin-Brandenburg factory as the company seeks to boost production of its autonomous Cybercab

By

Tesla TSLA 0.95 % increase; up pointing triangle will invest around 3 billion euros ($3.31 billion) to add a new facility at its Berlin-Brandenburg factory in Germany as Elon Musk’s electric-vehicle maker seeks to boost production of its autonomous Cybercab days after opening sales to select customers.

Factory lead Andre Thierig wrote in a LinkedIn post that Tesla would use the new production facility to produce the Cybercab starting in 2029, and eventually ramp up output to 1 million vehicles per year. Thierig said construction of the new facility would begin in the first half of next year.
